round: R04 multiseed conflict evidence and multistep credit

counterfactual.continuation_policy: original protected selection; no further Agent interventions
counterfactual.prefix: identical population and RNG, replay exact saved original objective responses
counterfactual.stop: after min(10, remaining rounds) at unchanged original MaxNFE=300
counterfactual.gain: baseline running-best minus branch running-best at identical NFE, divided by pre-action archive std, clipped to [-20,20]
counterfactual.unchanged_action_index: all horizons exactly zero; no counterfactual objective calls
counterfactual.same_selected_index_configs: share one branch but retain separate named action labels; different origins at identical coordinates are not merged
counterfactual.information_boundary: Only historical generated-function labels; current unevaluated candidate targets never sent to an Agent

retention: All baseline states counted; retain cases if at least one config changes the executed candidate index; separately record actual point and operator changes
context_bins: Proxy/Residual best-candidate agreement crossed with remaining budget below 0.15

calibration_support_rule.averaging: mean within function-seed episode, then seed-balanced within function, then function-balanced

runtime_support: At least 2 changed retrieved cases from distinct training functions, positive five-round mean and nonnegative ten-round mean, plus calibration support
confirmatory_functions: the 7 calibration function families, fresh independent seeds; not unseen functions
confirmatory_selection: fixed before outcomes, run regardless of whether calibration supports an action
limitations: Frozen anchor was pretrained on all36 function families
Five/ten-round deviation values are not full terminal returns or on-policy multi-action values
R04 changes evidence target and action cadence together; it is not a cadence-only ablation
Benchmark suite from previous rounds already inspected; no new benchmark improvement claim from this collection experiment
